vulnerabilities.name: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability

vulnerabilities.title: Linux Kernel
vulnerabilities.name: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.
vulnerabilities.cisaNotes: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. vulnerabilities.title: Google Brotli
vulnerabilities.name: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
